users.name: Alice Test User
users.purpose: Primary test user with admin privileges for testing backfill and admin endpoints

users.name: Bob Test User
users.purpose: Regular user for testing user isolation and access control

users.name: Carol Test User
users.purpose: Additional user for testing cross-user isolation (no data leakage)

userIsolation.description: Verify that test_user_001 cannot see data from test_user_002 or test_user_003
userIsolation.expectedBehavior: Each user only sees their own knowledge graph nodes

adminAccess.description: Verify that test_user_001 (admin) can access admin endpoints
adminAccess.expectedBehavior: Admin user gets 200 OK, regular users get 403 Forbidden

emptyKnowledgeGraph.description: Verify semantic search handles empty knowledge graph gracefully
emptyKnowledgeGraph.expectedBehavior: Returns empty results with meaningful message

concurrentQueries.description: Test concurrent semantic queries from multiple users
concurrentQueries.expectedBehavior: All queries return correct results without data leakage

metadata.purpose: Test user accounts for validation and security testing
metadata.note: Password hashes generated with bcrypt cost 12 for testing
